sources.title: Presidential Memorandum October11 2019
sources.short_quote: Agencies shall adhere to the terms of collective bargaining agreements executed while the injunction was in effect.
sources.finding: Conditional amendment and CBA protection; signed2019-10-11, published2019-10-21. Does not date mandate exactly. Describes injunction asAug25, conflicting with actual appellate citation toAug24 order.

sources.title: AFGE v Trump 929F3d748, No18-5289
sources.short_quote: We hold that the district court lacked jurisdiction and vacate its judgment.
sources.finding: Judicial opinion decidedJuly16; p6 cites actual Order at2–3 datedAug24 2018,Dkt57. Vacatur based on jurisdiction, not merits endorsement of all commands.

sources.title: OPM Updated Guidance October4 2019
sources.short_quote: On October 3, 2019, the Court of Appeals issued the mandate
sources.finding: Agency primary witness fixes mandate dateOct3; resumes formerly enjoined requirements; rescinds Aug29/Nov8 guidance; reinstates July5 guidance. Actual judicial mandate remains separately requested.

sources.title: OPM Guidance Implementation EO14003 March5 2021
sources.short_quote: All materials issued by the LRG are hereby rescinded.
sources.finding: Own March5 rescission of all target guidance and LRG materials is a separate event from Jan22 EO revocation. CBA rollback requires engagement consistent with law. Section8 reporting continues under independent OPM authority. Attachment dates model languageJuly13 2020 and reportDec17 2020, not presidential receipt. Modern file carries EO14148 rescission notice; retain version caveat.

sources.title: 73FLRA No96 AFGE Council119 and USCIS,0-AR-5709
sources.page_or_item: 73FLRA490ff, PDF p1 & fn8, merits following pages
sources.short_quote: the agreement will be automatically extended until the new agreement is negotiated
sources.finding: Primary adjudication: CBA beginningJuly1 2016 continued during successor bargaining; USCIS Jan2020 official-time restriction conflicted with continued agreement; FLRA remanded after EOrevocation. fn8 identifies mandateDoc1809309 filedOct3 2019. Search read, direct open403; full primary raw/pages not verified yet.

sources.title: OPM CBA Submission Guidance November20 2018
sources.short_quote: sections of EO 13836 requiring submission of collective bargaining agreements and arbitration awards were unaffected
sources.finding: Section8 unaffected by injunction; prescribes two forms and submission method; no proof all agencies submitted. Prior July5 guidance existence stated; exact initial format/date not established.

sources.title: OPM CBA Database release January9 2020
sources.short_quote: OPM is uploading all CBAs submitted by agencies over the past year to the CBA Database.
sources.finding: Database release and ongoing uploading demonstrate performance but not completion of continuing public-access duty or every agency instance; supersedesNov20 guidance.

sources.title: OPM TFUT FY2019 report October2020
sources.short_quote: preventing publication of the Governmentwide report by the June 30, 2020 deadline
sources.finding: Actual report and analysis occurred; cover monthOctober2020 is document month, public release day not proven; explicitly delayed data receipt prevents using June30 deadline as performance. Does not exhaust recurring annual duty.

sources.title: 85FR65940 OPM final rule October16 2020
sources.finding: Final rule issued under congressionally vested authority and assists only portions ofEO13839; explicitly anticipates further revisions for formerly enjoined provisions. Rulemaking step performed, entire section7(a) not exhausted by it.

sources.title: 87FR67765 OPM rescission rule November10 2022
sources.finding: Partial rescission of2020 regulation effectiveDec12 2022; confirms separate rule residue. p16 says collection discontinued withEO14003, but citesSection5 where original collection duty isSection6; preserve discrepancy.

sources.title: OPM January30 2026 FY2025 TFUT reporting
sources.short_quote: OPM requires agencies subject to the Federal Service Labor-Management Relations Statute
sources.finding: New agency reporting instruction, no express restoration ofEO13837 in its text. Similar task does not reconstitute revoked order. Says last report before2025 wasFY2019.

sources.title: NTIA petition July27 2020
sources.finding: Actual petition asks FCC to clarifySection230; exact filing independently corroborated by receiving agency same-day statement.

sources.title: FCC Commissioner Starks statement July27 2020
sources.short_quote: Today, the National Telecommunications & Information Administration (NTIA) filed a petition for rulemaking
sources.finding: Receiving agency contemporaneous statement supports exact petition filingJuly27 2020. Commissioner opposition is no dismissal or cessation of otherEOcommands.

sources.title: DOJ proposedSection230 legislation September23 2020
sources.short_quote: the Department of Justice sent draft legislation to Congress
sources.finding: DOJ confirms draft sentSept23 and executesEOdirective. Specific develop-a-proposal task completed bySept23, earliest drafting/completion date not shown. Congressional receipt unnecessary to duty to develop.

sources.title: WhiteHouse StateAG roundtable September23 2020
sources.short_quote: we’re here today as part of the President’s executive order on preventing online censorship
sources.finding: Actual consultation event with namedStateAGs and confirmedlegislationsent; not proof formal workinggroup established or modellegislation completed.

sources.title: EO14003 formal revocation
sources.finding: Present-tense hereby revocation with no deferred effective clause; signing-date command extinction proposed, publication kept separately.

sources.title: EO14029 formal revocation
sources.finding: Present-tense hereby revocation with no deferred effective clause; signing-date command extinction proposed, publication kept separately.

sources.title: D.C. Circuit actual mandate, court-authored university mirror
sources.page_or_item: PDF p1, filed stamp and mandate text
sources.short_quote: this constitutes the formal mandate of this court.
sources.finding: Actual court document bears Filed On October 3, 2019 [1809309], invokes judgment July 16 and FRAP 41. Clerk signature block and case identity agree with OPM and FLRA witnesses. University hosting is not official court custody; original authentication remains open. Index label October 7 conflicts with document and is rejected.
